name: Broxtowe

licensing.additional: No additional HMO licensing scheme; the council runs only national mandatory HMO licensing (five or more people from two or more households). Separately, an Article 4 direction since 26 March 2022 means converting a house to a small HMO in parts of Beeston and Beeston Rylands needs planning permission.

housing: Broxtowe lies on the western edge of Nottingham. Beeston, next to the University of Nottingham, has a large student and young professional rental market in Victorian terraces and inter-war houses. Stapleford, Chilwell and Toton are mainly inter-war and post-war semis and bungalows. The north of the borough, around Eastwood and Kimberley, is former coalfield with terraced miners' housing.
checkinTips: Student houses in Beeston near the university: photograph each bedroom lock, fire doors, smoke alarms and the shared kitchen in detail.
Victorian and miners' terraces in Eastwood, Kimberley and Stapleford: photograph rear yards, outside drains and any damp in rear rooms.
Homes near the River Trent in Attenborough and Beeston Rylands: photograph walls near floor level and gardens for signs of flooding.
Inter-war semis in Chilwell and Bramcote: photograph extensions, conservatories and garages.
New homes near the Toton tram stop: note snagging marks, parking spaces and management company areas.
tenantHelp: Tenants can report disrepair, damp or unsafe homes to Broxtowe Borough Council's private sector housing team, which can inspect and take enforcement action.
